items.title: U.S. jobs report substantially exceeds expectations
items.summary: October payroll growth exceeded the Reuters consensus, while unemployment edged lower. The report suggests greater labor-market resilience; the Scout's assessment is that persistent interest-rate pressure remains a risk to technology valuations. Watch Treasury yields, inflation data and subsequent payroll revisions.

observations.label: October nonfarm payroll growth — November 6 release

items.key_finding: Stronger-than-expected employment supports economic resilience while keeping interest-rate risk in focus.

sources.title: Reuters via MarketScreener — November 6, 2026, 8:31 AM ET futures reaction

items.title: Semiconductor selling spreads across Asian markets
items.summary: Asian semiconductor shares followed the U.S. technology rout lower. South Korea triggered a trading halt, while Japanese chip-related shares also fell sharply. These early-session observations establish international market stress; they do not establish a decline in semiconductor customer orders.

observations.label: KOSPI — November 6 early-session low
observations.value: Down as much as 8.8%; 20-minute circuit-breaker halt

observations.label: Nikkei 225 — November 6 early trading
observations.value: Approximately −5% to −6%; intraday, not closing data

items.key_finding: International semiconductor selling confirms broader repricing, while underlying demand deterioration remains unproven.

sources.title: DW with AFP and Reuters — November 6, 2026 Asian technology selloff
Bloomberg via SWI — November 6, 2026 early Asian markets

items.title: Atlassian earnings strength meets growth-outlook pressure
items.summary: Atlassian beat first-quarter revenue and adjusted earnings expectations, yet shares fell sharply as investors focused on slower subscription growth guidance. The Scout treats this as an earnings-related valuation dislocation; the price decline alone does not establish undervaluation. Watch subscription ARR, cloud growth and AI monetization.

observations.label: November 6 premarket indication
observations.value: Approximately −16%; historical premarket observation, not a live quote

items.key_finding: The earnings beat did not offset investor concern over the growth outlook.

sources.title: Atlassian company release via FT — November 5, 2026 fiscal Q1 2027 results
Investing.com — November 5–6, 2026 earnings and premarket dislocation

items.title: Lam Research authorizes $25 billion in share repurchases
items.summary: Lam announced a large repurchase authorization and its quarterly dividend during semiconductor-sector repricing. The Scout views the announcement as evidence of management's capital-return priorities, while customer spending remains a key risk. Authorization permits purchases but does not establish that shares have been repurchased.

observations.label: November 5 board announcement
observations.value: $25 billion share-repurchase authorization, supplementing prior remaining balances

observations.label: Quarterly dividend
observations.value: $0.33 per share; payable January 6, 2027 to holders of record December 2, 2026

observations.label: Repurchase conditions
observations.value: No termination date; may be suspended or discontinued; no obligation to purchase

items.key_finding: The authorization is a material capital-allocation announcement, not a guarantee of executed buybacks or future equipment demand.

sources.title: Lam Research — November 5, 2026 repurchase authorization and dividend release
